findings.description: The KMS key used to encrypt the logs bucket does not set enable_key_rotation, so it defaults to false and the key material is never automatically rotated. Long-lived key material increases the impact window if the key is ever compromised and violates common cryptographic key-management requirements.

findings.issue_category: No key policy defined (implicit account-wide access)
findings.description: No explicit key policy is attached, so AWS applies the default policy granting the entire account root principal full control over the key, allowing any IAM principal with sufficient IAM permissions to use or manage the key rather than a least-privilege set of log-writing/reading principals.
